name: Zombieman

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to a single target for 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to an entire enemy row for 4500% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] (affected only by advanced DMG modifiers), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. In the first 6 rounds, casting the Ultimate has a 120% chance to inflict [Blind] on the main target and 1 random enemy for 1 round. ———- [Blind]: lowers [Arena DMG Reduction] by 20%, prevents using the Ultimate and chasing; at most 2 can coexist; counts as a [Stun]-type effect.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Additionally grants all allies 15% [Rage] and [Break Armor]. [Specialized Direct DMG] 4500% > 6000% ATK; ignores [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%. The [Blind] window extends to the first 6 > 7 rounds with chance 120% > 180%, and [Blind] lowers [Arena DMG Reduction] 20% > 30%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20 Max HP. On entry, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] and becomes immune to [Blind]. Before any character acts, dispels [Stun], [Specialized Stun], [Deterrent] and [Silence] from all allies. At the start of Round 3, clears [Life Link] from all enemies. During the first 4 rounds, same-column allies cast their Ultimate for 0 Energy.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] on entry 60% > 70%. Free-cost Ultimate window 4 > 5 rounds.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] on entry 70% > 80%. Free-cost Ultimate window 5 > 6 rounds.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On taking fatal damage, triggers [Specialized Regeneration]. ———- [Specialized Regeneration]: On entry, permanently reduces damage taken by 30%. While allies are present, before the user's next action, the user fully heals and keeps fighting, raising own ATK by 15% and Max HP by 30% (stackable), up to 3 triggers. After triggering, the user takes no damage until the end of their own action.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Damage reduction 30% > 60%. Max triggers 3 > 4. Additionally, when a same-row ally triggers [Re-Battle] while the user is in [Specialized Regeneration], launch [Charged Pursuit] at 120% skill power.

effects.desc: 20% off Arena DMG Free, can't use ultimate, can't attack. Maximum 2 layers; Counts as a stun type effect.
The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
Attach deployer's life to an ally; cannot be defeated as long as that ally is alive.
Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
When entering battle, permanently reduces damage; While allies remain, heal to full health and continue fighting a limited number of times.

bio: A new URplus awakening of Zombieman — the “Heavy Vanguard” (重装先锋): an undying Duelist frontline that cleanses crowd-control for the team, blinds and pierces enemy defenses, and revives with stacking ATK/HP. CV: Takahiro Sakurai.
